description: This file contains functions for code generation, action handling, device options sanitization, signal mapping, keyboard modifier conversions, and click options for Playwright's codegen tool.

methods.name: generateCode
methods.description: Generates code text from actions using a language generator and options.

methods.name: generateActionText
methods.description: Creates a string representation of an action, optionally including an auto-generated expect statement.

methods.name: sanitizeDeviceOptions
methods.description: Removes properties from device options that match the device descriptor.

methods.name: toSignalMap
methods.description: Maps signals in an action to specific signal types (popup, download, dialog).

methods.name: toKeyboardModifiers
methods.description: Converts a bitmask of keyboard modifiers to an array of modifier strings.

methods.name: fromKeyboardModifiers
methods.description: Converts an array of modifier strings to a bitmask number.

methods.name: toClickOptionsForSourceCode
methods.description: Creates mouse click options for source code based on a click action.
